primary_goal: make persisted component-preset state structurally coherent instead of silently accepting contradictory or lossy records
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

scope.phase: startup, page/detail reload, and mutation reload
scope.trigger: contradictory top-level structure, non-canonical version, duplicate JSON keys/IDs, invalid tombstones, alias conflicts, or override/remove overlap

problem_domain_closure.json_parser: duplicate object keys and non-finite constants rejected
problem_domain_closure.preset_records: duplicate IDs, wrapper records, and conflicting aliases rejected
problem_domain_closure.tombstones: string format and duplicate IDs validated
problem_domain_closure.startup_read_write_api: all use ComponentPresetPersistenceError and prior HTTP catalog_unavailable mapping
problem_domain_closure.compatibility: valid built-in overrides/tombstones and format-valid unknown tombstone IDs retained

data_roles.comparison: isolated parent-commit behavior and candidate behavior
data_roles.holdout: duplicate JSON key, NaN/Infinity, alias wrapper, and valid built-in cases

guardrails: reject contradictory persisted state before publishing overrides/removed
retain format-valid tombstones for removed custom or future IDs
preserve H13 catalog_unavailable envelope and client CRUD statuses
run clean .venv full suite before promotion
next_step: review source-field canonicalization and metadata semantic validation as a separate schema-depth hypothesis
